name: MentionChip
purpose: Inline @mention chip for an attachment inside a note body. It is an atom: it cannot be typed into and deletes as one unit.

values.when: Click opens the attachment in the lightbox.

role: none (inline atom); button if it becomes focusable (proposed)
keyboard: Click opens. Delete or Backspace removes it as one unit (the reference says it deletes as a single unit; the key is not recorded).
open: Conflict: B lists this under notWidgets as owned by the rich-text editor family; A keeps it as a widget with its only recorded axis (source). Kept here with A's measured source until the family decision. Look is not measured. Present in note HTML only (count 0 in trees).
